integrity: The lower bound is an exact geometric reduction followed by a complete three-case boundary-side analysis in Q(sqrt(5)); the published construction supplies the matching upper bound. A symbolic checker verifies the algebraic identities but is not used in place of the quantified proof.
scientific_limitations: The result settles only the affine-regular decagon, i.e. j=1 in the conjectured P_{8j+2} family. It does not settle higher members of that family, the P_{8j+6} family, or classify all optimal parallelograms.
title: Banach–Mazur distance from the parallelogram to the regular decagon
